title: Add a tally feature that accepts untrusted input
prompt: Add a new feature directory src/main/features/tally. Its domain code (domain/tally.ts) exposes tally(input: unknown), which returns { kind: 'counted', count } with the number of non-blank strings when input is an array, and { kind: 'invalid-input' } for anything that is not an array. Its adapter runTally(input: unknown, writer) writes 'Counted <count>' or 'Invalid input', each followed by a newline, to the writer. The feature's index.ts exports runTally and nothing else. Wire it into src/main/composition-root.ts as a new exported function tallyMain(input: unknown): void that writes to standard output, next to main. Do not change the greeting feature. Add tests in test/tally.test.ts. The release is today: run nitpicker-gate until it exits 0.
